expectations.text: Findings are verified or scoped mobile-first, since 81% of sessions and spend are mobile.
expectations.evidence: Mobile is acknowledged in only two places, both peripheral to the findings themselves: the Could Not Check section notes that speed, accessibility (contrast, tap targets, keyboard focus), form field count and 'layout stability on the 81%-mobile traffic is unchecked', and one RE-CHECK line specifies 'land → product-page click-through rate on mobile paid social'. The four FIX NOW findings are written viewport-agnostically: fix 1 (CTA destination/price surfacing), fix 2 (headline), fix 3 (hero visual) and fix 4 (shipping cost timing) contain no mobile framing at all — no mention of what is above

expectations.text: Findings are verified or scoped mobile-first, since 81% of sessions and spend are mobile.
expectations.evidence: Mobile share is surfaced prominently and treated as a gap: 'This is your first fix, not a finding — you're flying blind on 4 in 5 dollars', plus a mobile-scoped secondary finding ('Mobile-heavy traffic + collage hero ... likely Largest Contentful Paint / load-time tax') and fix #6 'Split mobile vs desktop reporting'. However, the five critical findings (message match, CTA mismatch, hidden price, shipping surprise, no instrumentation) are stated device-agnostically — no mobile viewport/fold framing, tap targets, Meta in-app browser behavior, mobile checkout flow, or whether the LP renders well
